02 / 一个真实案例

数字不同，先检查设定。

以下结果来自同一历史运行的两条设定。数值按四位小数展示；打开来源可核对完整记录。

历史运行回放 · 2026-09-07 UTC · Card 1995

A OLS
0.0747

控制变量后的相关估计

样本量 3010 · 标准误 0.003498
协方差: HC1
B IV
0.1315

使用大学邻近的工具变量估计

样本量 3010 · 标准误 0.054964
协方差: nonrobust
改变了什么

估计器从 OLS 变为 IV；IV 使用 nearc4（大学邻近）作工具。协方差也从 HC1 变为 nonrobust，标准误并非完全同口径。

保持了什么

同一数据、教育年限与对数工资；同一经验二次项、人口与地区控制；两条估计的样本量均为 3010。

查看数据与计算来源 ↗
不能据此说：教育对每个人的工资都有相同因果影响。

OLS 展示控制变量后的相关。IV 的解释依赖工具变量相关性、排除限制等假设；强度诊断不能单独证明工具有效。估计值更大，也不等于更接近真值。

复现待核：这是一组历史结果，不代表跨环境数值已复现。

02 / A REAL EXAMPLE

Different numbers. Inspect the specifications.

Both estimates come from the same historical run. Values are rounded to four decimal places; open the sources for the full record.

Historical run replay · 2026-09-07 UTC · Card 1995

A OLS
0.0747

Conditional association estimate

Observations 3010 · Standard error 0.003498
Covariance: HC1
B IV
0.1315

Instrumental-variable estimate using college proximity

Observations 3010 · Standard error 0.054964
Covariance: nonrobust
What changed

OLS becomes IV, using nearc4 (college proximity) as an instrument. Covariance also changes from HC1 to nonrobust; the standard errors are not directly like-for-like.

What stayed fixed

The dataset, education and log wage; quadratic experience, demographic and regional controls. Both estimates have 3,010 observations.

Inspect data & calculation sources ↗
You cannot conclude: education has the same causal effect on everyone’s wages.

OLS shows a conditional association. Interpreting IV depends on instrument relevance, exclusion and other assumptions; a strength diagnostic cannot establish instrument validity on its own. A larger estimate need not be closer to the truth.

Reproduction pending verification. These historical results do not establish cross-environment numerical replication.
